title: St John Ambulance: do not make a poisoned person vomit, and do not give them food or drink
summary: Ask what was swallowed, when, and how much. Call 999 or 112. Keep the packaging.
body: St John Ambulance's poisoning page says that if the person is responsive, ask what they swallowed, when, and how much. Packaging, containers, or plants nearby may be clues. Call 999 or 112 and give as much of that information as you can. Keep packaging or labels. Keep checking breathing and response. Do not try to make them vomit. If they vomit, put some of it in a bag or container for the clinicians, along with the other clues. Do not give them anything to eat or drink. If they become unresponsive, open the airway, check breathing, and prepare to give CPR. This is about a swallowed poison. It is not a list of substances, and it is not a method for using any of them.
